description: RadialSpectrum is a modern radial visualization suite for Microsoft Power BI, delivering three distinct chart types — Radial, Radial Bar, and Circular Chart — in a single certified visual. Designed for analysts and business users who need compact, visually engaging charts without sacrificing analytical depth, RadialSpectrum combines powerful formatting controls with a clean, data-first design. Whether you are building a KPI scorecard, tracking progress against a goal, or comparing multiple categories in a tight report layout, RadialSpectrum gives you the flexibility and polish to do it right — without custom code or complex workarounds. Three Chart Types in One Visual Radial. Renders your measure as proportional slices around a circle — ideal for category share and contribution analysis. Four style variants are available: Classic, Exploded, Segmented, and Rounded Radial Burst. Configurable inner radius, slice spacing, rotation, and chart scale give you full control over the layout. Radial Bar. Renders each category as a radial arc whose length reflects the measure value — perfect for KPI tracking and goal attainment displays. Choose from 14 visual styles (Classic, Neon Glow, Soft Glass, 3D Extruded, Heatmap Intensity, Gradient Metallic, and more) and 10 shape variants (Rounded Capsule, Tapered, Arrow Tip, Diamond End, and others).
